_comment: RoadAware v2 preparation config (notebook 10): date-evidence repair, unknown-label flags, province-day and province x 6 h panels, as-of external features and leakage audit. NO model fitting. Relative paths resolve against the backend root. Env overrides (set by backend/scripts/run_v2_notebooks.py): ROADAWARE_BACKEND_ROOT, ROADAWARE_V1_DATA_ROOT (read-only v1 root), ROADAWARE_V2_EXTERNAL_ROOT (read-only for 10: notebook 09 raw/derived), ROADAWARE_V2_SOURCES_DIR (read-only notebook 09 report dir), ROADAWARE_V2_OUTPUT_ROOT (root for reports/v2/preparation), ROADAWARE_V2_DATA_ROOT (row/panel matrices, gitignored). Status: research only, production_ready false, operational BLOCKED.

panel.label_meaning: y_recorded_count = number of SELECTED retained MOT-source records in the cell (event-time label only). A zero in a known cell means no selected recorded event, not a proven true zero. Cells with training_eligible false are unknown labels, never zeros.

date_repair.policy: Original cached MOT CSV rows only (v1 row_audit lineage). A v1 ambiguous slash-date row is repaired only when notebook 09 resolved it (exact ACC_CODE, every XLSX row of the ID has the same TYPED date, every CSV row of the ID has the same raw date string, the typed date is one of the row's own candidates) AND notebook 10 independently re-checks the publisher-counterpart context: every XLSX row of the ID has the same province key (exact audited alias map on both sides) and the same HH:MM time as the original CSV row. Missing context on either side is NOT treated as verified (row stays ambiguous, reason recorded). v1 unambiguous dates are never changed. id_conflict_* groups stay quarantined. No XLSX-only rows. 2026 stays diagnostic.

no_candidate_date_policy_options.v1_count_only: rows with no candidate date are counted per province-year (audit column unplaceable_rows_province_year, never a feature); no day can be flagged, so these province-years carry an explicit coverage caveat (same as v1)
no_candidate_date_policy_options.flag_province_year: flag every day of the source year for the row's province (all 77 when province unknown)

festivals.sign_convention: signed distance = target date - nearest festival day (0 inside the festival, negative before the first day, positive after the last day); nearest occurrence searched in the previous, same and next year; clipped to [-clip_days, clip_days]

season.note: simplistic national calendar-month proxy (hot Mar-May, wet Jun-Oct, cool Nov-Feb); not observed rain, not proof all regions share these seasons

weather.note: JMA GSM previous_day2 (nominal ~48 h lead) archived forecast at the province representative point; feature only when every hour is present (no partial sums) and latest nominal issue bound + 6 h <= issue time; otherwise NaN (train-only imputation later). Never target-day observations/reanalysis.

traffic.note: newest PRIOR survey year (survey_year_ce < target year) whose catalog proxy available_from (max(created, last_modified) + 1 day) <= issue time; no target-year actuals, no future/nearest backfill; missing -> NaN. Catalog proxy does not prove historical bytes.

features.name: time_block
features.assumptions: block of the TARGET cell; event times are labels only

features.name: fest_songkran_dist
features.assumptions: fixed civil dates; observed-day shifts not modelled

features.name: bank_holiday_asof
features.unit: 0/1, NaN when coverage unknown at issue
features.source: reviewed BOT bank-holiday records (09 calendar_records.csv, applied only)
features.assumptions: bank holiday != public holiday; known_from is a conservative proxy, historical latency unproven

features.name: bank_calendar_known_asof
features.assumptions: source-availability flag known at issue; 1 never claims a complete calendar

features.name: wx_rain_sum_mm_d2
features.unit: mm per target day (sum of 24 preceding-hour values)
features.source: Open-Meteo Previous Runs JMA GSM previous_day2
features.available_at: latest nominal issue bound + 6 h <= issue
features.assumptions: representative point, nominal lead, delivery latency unverified

features.name: wx_temp_mean_c_d2
features.unit: deg C mean of 24 instant values
features.source: Open-Meteo Previous Runs JMA GSM previous_day2
features.available_at: latest nominal issue bound + 6 h <= issue

features.name: wx_block_rain_sum_mm_d2
features.unit: mm per target block (6 preceding-hour values)
features.source: Open-Meteo Previous Runs JMA GSM previous_day2
features.available_at: latest nominal issue bound + 6 h <= issue

features.name: wx_block_temp_mean_c_d2
features.unit: deg C mean of 6 instant values
features.source: Open-Meteo Previous Runs JMA GSM previous_day2
features.available_at: latest nominal issue bound + 6 h <= issue

features.name: trf_mean_aadt
features.unit: vehicles/day, mean over DOH survey-point station rows
features.available_at: newest prior vintage with proxy available_from <= issue
features.assumptions: never a provincial total; catalog proxy

features.name: trf_mean_heavy_share_pct
features.unit: % heavy vehicles, mean over valid station rows

features.name: trf_n_station_rows
features.assumptions: coverage of survey points, not traffic volume

pending_groups.history: PENDING: conditional history sensitivity not implemented; historical publication availability is unverified and Codex must confirm a separate scenario after the primary experiment (30-day minimum delay assumption per v2-feature-policy).

caveats: labels are selected recorded MOT-source counts (MOT road network only), not complete all-road accidents
date repair relies on the publisher's own XLSX counterpart (not independent ground truth)
training_eligible is an outcome-derived offline research filter, unavailable for prospective claims
weather: nominal JMA GSM lead; historical public delivery latency unverified; coverage may be quota-partial
traffic: catalog-vintage proxy does not prove historical bytes; revised resources push availability later
bank calendar: reviewed BOT transcriptions with conservative known_from; later amendments unknown; not a public-holiday calendar
no model has been fitted or compared in notebook 10
